text.p: AlphaNet Solutions Inc Monday said it decided to postpone, for an indefinite period, a proposed follow-on offering of 2.0 million shares of its common stock due to market conditions.
Shares of the single-source provider of information technology products, services and support rose 1-5/8 to 13-5/8.

"The company believes that the current trading prices of its common stock do not appropriately reflect the company's recent operating results or its near-term prospects," said Stan Gang, chairman, president, and chief executive officer.

In addition, the company has secured a commitment from First Union National Bank for a revolving line of credit for up to $15 million, an increase from the previous line of credit of $7 million. Such facility includes a $5 million acquisition line, although no acquisitions currently are being planned or negotiated by the company.
